stable-diffusion.cpp version future-rename
Usage: /sd-cli [options]

CLI Options:
  -o, --output <string>                         path to write result image to
  -v, --verbose                                 print extra info

Context Options:
  -m, --model <string>                          path to full model
  --diffusion-model <string>                    path to the standalone diffusion model
  --vae <string>                                path to standalone vae model

Generation Options:
  -p, --prompt <string>                         the prompt to render
  -n, --negative-prompt <string>                the negative prompt
  -H, --height <int>                            image height
  -W, --width <int>                             image width
  --sample-steps <int>                          number of sample steps
  --txt-cfg <float>                             text guidance scale
  -s, --seed                                    RNG seed
  --new-turbo-flag                              enable a newly added turbo path
